title: Phone: Carver Kidney Center — do we stop dialysis?

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Carver Kidney Center
transcript.text: This is the charge nurse at Carver Kidney Center. The radio says the water plant was hacked.

transcript.speaker: Carver Kidney Center
transcript.text: We run dialysis on City water through our own treatment, but our water tech needs to know if your chlorine or anything else changed this morning.

transcript.speaker: Carver Kidney Center
transcript.text: Do we stop treatments? Why hasn’t anyone called us?

voiceStyles.Carver Kidney Center: Woman in her 50s, clinical and worried, monitors beeping behind

instructorNote: A critical customer heard it on the radio first. Watch for the printed critical-customer list, a call-back from the Water Quality Manager within 15 minutes and the sample facts.

snapshot.title: Phone Call: Health Commissioner — Boil Water Demand for Zone 3

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Dr. Elena Vance
transcript.text: This is Dr. Elena Vance, Carver County Health Commissioner. I’m calling to demand a public advisory for Zone 3. The emergency interconnect (IC-1) must be activated within the hour. I need to know if the water is safe to drink and whether we’re under a boil-water order.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Elena Vance
transcript.text: The media is already reporting that people are drinking from hydrants. I’m sending a car to the plant. We cannot wait.

transcript.speaker: Public Information Officer
transcript.text: Dr. Vance, thank you for calling. I’m on the line with the Water Quality Manager and the Director. We’re in manual mode, and the lab is still down. I’m confirming the zone boundaries now.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Elena Vance
transcript.text: I’m not asking for confirmation. I’m issuing a public health directive. The interconnect is at risk. The public is already exposed. You must act now.

transcript.speaker: Public Information Officer
transcript.text: Understood. I’m initiating the Boil Water Advisory template now. I’ll verify with the WQ Manager and release within 15 minutes.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Elena Vance
transcript.text: Good. I expect a full advisory to be published before 12:00. The media is going to break this. I’ll call back at 11:50 to confirm.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Elena Vance
transcript.text: Do not delay. The health risk is real.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject tests the PIO’s adherence to the advisory release protocol under pressure. Watch for premature public release without WQ verification, and ensure the Deputy PIO opens the media log immediately after the call.
